$ headroom accounts add f@x.com --share-config
exit 0
--- stdout
seeded $BASE/home/.claude-accounts/f@x.com
  projects → $BASE/home/.claude/projects (sessions are machine-global)
  shared nothing from $BASE/home/.claude (no matching entries)
next: HOME=$BASE/home headroom launch --account f@x.com   then /login as f@x.com
      (the board warns if the login does not match the dir name; new accounts sort last until listed in $BASE/home/.claude-accounts/.order)
--- stderr
